generation.scenarioLabels: Existing generator ground truth reused unchanged; all injected episodes start in holdout.

B_DETAILED_AUTH.description: USER_REGISTERED, LOGIN_SUCCESS, LOGIN_FAILED, LOGOUT plus ORDER, ADMIN_DENIED, PRODUCT_ADMIN, OTHER.

C_DETAILED_ACTIONS.description: One category per mapped action meeting the per-seed calibration frequency threshold; rare and unknown actions map to OTHER.
C_DETAILED_ACTIONS.thresholdUnit: Occurrences of the audit action across all users in that seed’s calibration period.

methodology.noFutureLeakage: Baseline precedes each current window; group C action eligibility is computed from calibration actions only; injected episodes begin in holdout.
methodology.scoring: A window is scored only when raw baseline/current event counts satisfy the configured minimums; insufficient windows are counted but excluded from confusion metrics.
methodology.holdoutExceedanceRateCaveat: Exceedance rate includes known positive synthetic episodes; false positive rate is computed only against benign-labeled holdout windows.
methodology.correlationCaveat: Non-overlap removes window overlap, but windows from the same synthetic user remain correlated; descriptive metrics are not confidence intervals.

limits: All results are SYNTHETIC and do not establish production detection performance.
Current rules, worker, incidents, database, risk score and severity were not changed or used.
The detailed-action model may increase divergence for sparse categories; alpha smoothing is unchanged, but operational threshold calibration needs real chronological data.
Three seeds and one deterministic generator describe only this synthetic design.
